references.context: General topology: sobriety of X, every nonempty irreducible closed subset has a unique generic point x whose closure equals that subset; not equivalent to Hausdorffness.
references.reason: Sobriety is an independent topological property required of spectral spaces.
references.matching_note: Preserve irreducible closed, nonempty, existence and uniqueness of generic point.

references.phrase: binary intersections of quasi-compact open sets remain quasi-compact
references.disposition: The closure of quasi-compact opens under binary intersection is an axiom defining the spectral-space structure, not a theorem valid in all quasi-compact spaces. The underlying notions are separately linked.
Every original open can be expressed as a union of quasi-compact opens, not necessarily as one quasi-compact open.

references.context: Set theory/topology: relative complements X\U of quasi-compact open U⊆X; these need not be open in the original spectral topology.
references.reason: The underlying complement operation is reusable and helps generate the patch topology.
references.matching_note: Candidate may overlap with existing relative-complement construction; retain the ambient X.

references.context: General topology: smallest topology on X containing a designated subbasis 𝒮, generated by arbitrary unions of finite intersections of members of 𝒮.
references.reason: Topology generation from a designated family is a reusable construction independent of the spectral patch topology.
references.matching_note: Compare to indexed topology-subbasis definition; distinct from the original topology.

references.disposition: The combined family forms a subbasis for the newly generated patch topology; it is not claimed to be a basis or a subbasis for the original spectral topology.

references.phrase: constructible subset in the source convention

references.context: General topology: arbitrary indexed open cover (V_i) of X, with union X and no finite-subcover requirement.
references.reason: The locally constructible test presupposes a family of open charts covering X.
references.matching_note: Compare globally with compactness open-cover candidate.

references.context: General topology: intersection E∩V_i of a subset E⊆X with an open subspace V_i⊆X, considered with the induced topology on V_i.
references.reason: Local restriction of a subset is independent of testing its constructibility on the chart.
references.matching_note: Do not infer global constructibility of E.

references.disposition: The locally constructible condition needs a suitable covering, not the statement that E is globally constructible.

references.context: General topology: locally closed subset A⊆X expressible as O∩F with O open and F closed in X, equivalently open in its closure.
references.reason: Local closedness is a reusable topological property of each partition piece.
references.matching_note: Do not conflate with merely closed or constructible.

references.context: Set theory: indexed partition X=⋃_i X_i by pairwise disjoint subsets covering all X, without requiring finitely many pieces or topology of a coproduct.
references.reason: A set partition is a reusable notion independent of a topological disjoint-union construction.
references.matching_note: Keep pairwise disjointness and coverage, not categorical coproduct properties.

references.phrase: all of X covered and pieces pairwise disjoint
references.disposition: No finiteness, ordering, or local finiteness of the family is required by this formulation.

references.context: General topology: family 𝒩_x of neighborhoods of x such that for every neighborhood U of x there exists B∈𝒩_x with B⊆U; B need not itself be open.
references.reason: Neighborhood-basis structure is independent of its requiring quasi-compact members.
references.matching_note: Preserve non-open neighborhoods allowed in source.

references.phrase: neighborhood of a point in a topological space
references.context: General topology: neighborhood N of point x if there exists an open U with x∈U⊆N, without requiring N to be open.
references.reason: The neighborhood concept is a prerequisite and may not be replaced by openness of N.
references.matching_note: Specific non-open neighborhood convention already deliberate in earlier correction.

references.disposition: The quasi-compact neighborhood K can depend on both x and U, and no ambient Hausdorff condition is asserted.
